depiction.primary_object: multi-story stepped building with square windows and central door

readings.meaning: apartment building / condo complex / rental property

ambiguity: Can denote any multi-story structure—an office, apartment block, hotel, or hospital—unless distinguished by another marker like a cross or bed.
task_intents: visit or commute to office building
deal with building management or HOA
manage commercial real estate or lease
handle municipal or city hall errands

example_tasks.task: Ask landlord whether they plan to repave the courtyard this year
Check which days the team is actually coming into the downtown office
Look up three mid-size architecture firms in Portland before sending portfolio
Drop off signed sublease forms at the property management office before five
Compare commercial space rates per square foot in the warehouse district
Find out if the building requires a certificate of insurance from the moving company
File the annual business registration renewal with the state corporation commission before the end of May

example_tasks_es: Pagar la cuota de la comunidad de vecinos de este trimestre
Llamar al administrador de la finca por la humedad del rellano
Reservar hotel cerca del centro para las dos noches en Madrid
example_tasks_ru: Позвонить в управляющую компанию по поводу домофона в подъезде
Забронировать отель рядом с вокзалом на три ночи в Казани
Забрать пропуск в главный офис на ресепшене до десяти утра

context_tasks.task: Water the snake plant on my desk on Wednesday
Bring spare HDMI adapter to the 4th floor conference room
Empty the office fridge before the long weekend
Measure the hallway doorway before ordering the sofa

near_misses.task: Print the boarding passes on the office printer before leaving
Check if the city library has the new translation in stock
Build a cedar raised bed for the tomatoes this weekend
Buy a new cordless drill for the apartment
Order replacement filters for the hospital-grade air purifier
Book annual physical at the downtown clinic

reasoning: A clear, classic multi-story building silhouette with windows and a central entrance. It works well for tasks about an office building, apartment complex, HOA/property management, company, or hotel, though it is generic across those building types unless more specific icons (like a house, bed, or hospital cross) apply.
